purpose: CUTOFF-retained state typicality only; not G2 admission, action-only-shift proof or BCA efficacy
seed_check_scope: Scoped known-family seed-identity check, no simulator/data outcomes: 2224 proposed resets distinct, no overlap with 6080 known prior resets; no raw-value collision with sealed named seeds. Not exhaustive repository-history attestation.

criteria.distance: standardized Euclidean to retained fitting rows; leave own episode out of reference queries
criteria.invalid_or_insufficient: INCONCLUSIVE, stop; no sample top-up, band change, radius change or threshold change
criteria.pass: Retained-state typicality supported on these independent development samples only; no conditional-action density or equality-of-state-distribution claim

size_rationale.assumptions: Episode-independent mixture/action streams and existing independent split; all deep episodes stay at high load. Worlds are paired, not independent replications. Only controls minimum group counts, not probability of passing distances.

data_policy: Preserve recorder/physics/mask; persist full arrays, group IDs, CUTOFF masks and query state/time identities; one fixed fresh development attempt. No selection or final-calibration fitting/access for decision. Existing consumed data remains development.
save_load_rule: Save already validated in-memory arrays directly. Never call KneeDataset/load for saved support analysis; a second dynamics validation would cost 409600 additional transitions and is outside this cap.
saved_artifacts: both complete dataset NPZ files with episode/group IDs, original role splits, raw states, observations, executed/requested actions, termination and recorder metadata
fitting-only NPZ exports and manifest hashes for launch_repaired.py support
CUTOFF boolean masks with retained row IDs, group denominators and source hashes
128 exact start states/observations and48 anchor states/observations/times, reset IDs and complete prefix actions
source/data/query hashes, immutable decision contract, global supervisor receipt, exact attempted/completed transitions and resets, D3 readout
existing_data_reuse: Existing JSON summaries/source identities/control rules only. Old datasets/calibration/checkpoints do not substitute for widened-recorder raw arrays. If authenticated original raw arrays are found, pure retained-only recomputation needs zero simulator transitions; its known 60-row group is still insufficient. New collection is independent development, never confirmation.

seed_check_receipt.evidence: Independent code reviewer seed-identity calculation in this task; no environment draws or transitions
